outputs.bab-01-moon-star: Night of the 11th, beginning of the night, the moon was 1 cubit 8 fingers in front of δ Capricorni.
outputs.bab-02-moon-planet: Night of the 2nd, beginning of the night, the moon was 1 1/2 cubits behind Jupiter, the moon being 1 cubit high to the north.
outputs.bab-03-planet-planet: Night of the 24th, first part of the night, Venus was 3 fingers below Mars, Venus 2 fingers back to the west.
outputs.bab-04-heliacal-rising: The 13th of month VIII, Venus appeared in the east, in Scorpius; it was bright, rising of Venus to sunrise: 10°; (ideal) first appearance on the 11th.
outputs.bab-05-lunar-first-visibility: Month IX, the 1st (of which followed the 30th of the preceding month); the moon was bright, first visibility, sunset to moonset: 17°, earthshine, low to the sun.
